lines: Forty-one years in that book and I have never once handed the pen to anybody else.
I did, this month. Twice. I wanted a second hand on it in case mine was wrong.
It was not wrong. I would have been a great deal happier if it had been wrong.
Somebody in this town writes down the weather every day. It has been me since I was twenty.
It is not important. That is exactly why it works: nobody has ever leaned on the number.
